scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix api"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix api
scripts.test: npm --prefix api run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix api run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix api run typecheck:test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck:test
